thread:
Lina (CS): We need a compact cost-readout for Aegis ahead of their QBR. Target: one slide + 3-minute talking points. Focus: current burn drivers, immediate fixes, and renewal levers. Can @Jordan (FinOps) and @Sam (Data Eng) pair on a per-feature cost breakdown?
Jordan (FinOps): Yup. I'll do cost-per-model + embeddings vs completions split. Need last 45 days and any scheduled job cadence. Can you share any notes about onboarding jobs?
Lina (CS): Customer runs a nightly patient-vector rebuild and an ad-hoc debug workflow. I uploaded a filtered export: https://redwood.internal/s3/aegis/usage_trim_45d.csv. Watch out for heavy embed spikes on 5/02 and 5/17.
Sam (Data Eng): I can run a quick ETL to bucket by feature. Will output: nightly-batch, web-session-embeds, debug-job, api-requests. ETA 4 hours.
Priya (AE): Renewal context: they're sensitive to variance. Prefers predictable spend. They've asked about Dedicated pricing delta and short-term credits while we remedy spikes.
Jordan (FinOps): I'll produce two scenarios: baseline (no fixes), mitigated (client patch + batching + cache). For Dedicated estimate, I'll apply our standard 20% committed discount and a simplified GPU utilization factor.
Lina (CS): Helpful. Also capture customer's ask: clearer embedding unit per-session metric and a dashboard tile. They want a signal before next nightly batch runs.
Sam (Data Eng): For the dashboard tile we can add a rolling-24h embedding-units metric and a boolean flag for 'batch-run-scheduled'. Quick query:

```
SELECT run_date, sum(embedding_units) as embeds
FROM usage
WHERE customer = 'aegis'
AND ts >= date_sub(current_date, 45)
GROUP BY run_date
ORDER BY run_date desc;
```

Sam (Data Eng): Will add the query to Grafana and create a heatmap panel.
Jordan (FinOps): Proposed short-term mitigations to present: 1) Temporarily cap nightly batch to X tokens (operational cap), 2) Apply client dedupe patch (saves ~15-20% embeds), 3) Turn on prefix caching for high-volume sessions. I'll quantify savings.
Lina (CS): For the QBR slide include a small table: MTD spend, projected EOM baseline, projected EOM mitigated, credit ask, and recommended next steps. Keep it one slide.
Priya (AE): I'll prep renewal bullets: why Dedicated could reduce variance, what to expect in commitment math, and an ask for a 3-month temporary credit to absorb the current overage while we deploy fixes.
Jordan (FinOps): Creating alert rules too: soft: +10% vs trailing-30d -> notify #cs-aegis + ae:priya, hard: +30% -> notify execs + finance. I'll include runbook steps for CS triage and SE escalation.
Lina (CS): Add customer comm line: "We're throttling nightly batch to prevent unexpected overages and will follow up with a forecast." Keep language customer-friendly.
release-bot: alert rule aegis_spend_v2 created: soft_threshold=10%, hard_threshold=30% -> channels: #cs-account-aegis, email:alerts+aegis@redwood.com (rule id: ar-1768-572)
Sam (Data Eng): ETL done and uploaded: https://redwood.internal/s3/aegis/feature_buckets_45d.csv. Early numbers show debug-job ~12% of embeds but disproportionately large per-run token count.
Jordan (FinOps): Draft forecasts attached (links): baseline_pdf: https://redwood.drafts/aegis_baseline.pdf ; mitigated_pdf: https://redwood.drafts/aegis_mitigated.pdf. Rough delta: mitigations ~22% lower EOM spend.
Lina (CS): Great. Final deliverables: one-pager slide (Lina), forecasts (Jordan), dashboard tile + heatmap (Sam), renewal bullets + ask (Priya). Can we aim to lock by EOD tomorrow?
Priya (AE): Yep, I'll have the talking points ready and coordinate customer pre-QBR email.
Jordan (FinOps): I'll revise numbers after the client patch lands; otherwise will present mitigated scenario as 'if patch deployed'.
Lina (CS): Thanks team 389. Tag me when documents are uploaded.
Priya (AE): Pinged Aegis to tentatively schedule QBR slot and confirm they want the cost slide.
Jordan (FinOps): Uploaded final calc to internal drive.
Lina (CS): Closing loop here when slide is in the QBR deck.
